17.sabates_a: Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, saying in his heart: Shall trowest thou to him that is an hundred year old a son be born? And Sara that is ninety years old shall she bear?
17.madueke_b: Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, saying in his heart: Shall trowest thou to him that is an hundred year old a son be born? And Sara that is ninety years old shall she bear?

18.s_dismas: And he ſaid to God: I would that Iſmael may liue before thee.
18.odr_com: And he said to God: I would that Ismael may liue before thee.
18.sabates_a: And he said to God: I would that Ismael may live before thee.
18.madueke_b: And he said to God: I would that Ismael may live before thee.

19.s_dismas: And God ſaid to Abraham: Sara thy wife shal beare thee a ſonne, and thou shalt cal his name Iſaac, and I wil eſtablish my couenant to him for a perpetual couenant, and to his ſeed after him.
19.odr_com: And God said to Abraham: Sara thy wife shal beare thee a sonne, and thou shalt cal his name Isaac, and I wil establish my couenant to him for a perpetual couenant, and to his seed after him.
19.sabates_a: And God said to Abraham: Sara thy wife shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name Isaac, and I will establish my covenant to him for a perpetual covenant, and to his seed after him.
19.madueke_b: And God said to Abraham: Sara thy wife shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name Isaac, and I will establish my covenant to him for a perpetual covenant, and to his seed after him.

20.s_dismas: Concerning Iſmael alſo I haue heard thee. Behold, I wil bleſſe him, and encreaſe, and multiplie him exceadingly: twelue dukes shal he beget, and I wil make him into a great nation.
20.odr_com: Concerning Ismael also I haue heard thee. behold, I wil blesse him, and encrease, and multiplie him exceadingly: twelue dukes shal he beget, and I wil make him into a great nation.
20.sabates_a: Concerning Ismael also I have heard thee. Behold, I will bless him, and increase and multiply him exceedingly: twelve Dukes shall he beget, and I will make him into a great Nation.
20.madueke_b: Concerning Ismael also I have heard thee. Behold, I will bless him, and increase and multiply him exceedingly: twelve Dukes shall he beget, and I will make him into a great Nation.

21.s_dismas: But my couenant I wil eſtablish with Iſaac, whom Sara shal bring forth to thee at this time an other yeare.
21.odr_com: But my couenant I wil establish with Isaac, whom Sara shal bring forth to thee at this time an other yeare.
21.sabates_a: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sara shall bring forth to thee at this time another year.
21.madueke_b: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sara shall bring forth to thee at this time another year.

22.s_dismas: And when he had leaft of ſpeaking with him, God aſcended from Abraham.
22.odr_com: And when he had leaft of speaking with him, God ascended from Abraham.
22.sabates_a: And when he had left off speaking with him, God ascended from Abraham.
22.madueke_b: And when he had left off speaking with him, God ascended from Abraham.

23.s_dismas: And Abraham tooke Iſmael his ſonne, and al the homebred of his houſe: and al whom he had bought, al the males of al the men of his houſe: and he circumciſed the flesh of their prepuce forthwith the very ſame day, as God had commanded him.
23.odr_com: And Abraham tooke Ismael his sonne, and al the homebred of his house: and al whom he had bought, al the males of al the men of his house: and he circumcised the flesh of their prepuce forthwith the very same day, as God had commanded him.
23.sabates_a: And Abraham took Ismael his son, and all the homebred of his house: and all whom he had bought, all the males of all the men of his house: and he circumcised the flesh of their prepuce forthwith the very same day, as God had commanded him.
23.madueke_b: And Abraham took Ismael his son, and all the homebred of his house: and all whom he had bought, all the males of all the men of his house: and he circumcised the flesh of their prepuce forthwith the very same day, as God had commanded him.

24.s_dismas: Abraham was nyntie and nyne yeares old, when he circumciſed the flesh of his prepuce.
24.odr_com: Abraham was nyntie and nyne yeares old, when he circumcised the flesh of his prepuce.
24.sabates_a: Abraham was ninety and nine years old, when he circumcised the flesh of his prepuce.
24.madueke_b: Abraham was ninety and nine years old, when he circumcised the flesh of his prepuce.

25.s_dismas: And Iſmael his ſonne was ful thirtene yeares old at the time of his circumciſion.
25.odr_com: And Ismael his sonne was ful thirtene yeares old at the time of his circumcision.
25.sabates_a: And Ismael his son was full thirteen years old at the time of his circumcision.
25.madueke_b: And Ismael his son was full thirteen years old at the time of his circumcision.

26.s_dismas: The ſelfsame day was Abraham circumciſed and Iſmael his ſonne.
26.odr_com: The selfsame day was Abraham circumcised and Ismael his sonne.
26.sabates_a: The self-same day was Abraham circumcised and Ismael his son.
26.madueke_b: The self-same day was Abraham circumcised and Ismael his son.

27.s_dismas: And al the men of his houſe, as wel the homebred, as the bought ſeruantes and ſtrangers were circumciſed togeather.
27.odr_com: And al the men of his house, as wel the homebred, as the bought seruantes and strangers were circumcised togeather.
27.sabates_a: And all the men of his house, as well the homebred as the bought servants and strangers were circumcised together.
27.madueke_b: And all the men of his house, as well the homebred as the bought servants and strangers were circumcised together.

janvier_by_verse.1: And after that he began to be ninety and nine years old, our Lord appeared unto him, and said unto him: I am the God almighty: walk before me, and be perfect.
janvier_by_verse.2: And I will make my covenant between me and thee: and I will multiply thee exceedingly.
janvier_by_verse.3: Abram fell flat on his face.
janvier_by_verse.4: And God said to him: I am, and my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many Nations.
janvier_by_verse.5: Neither shall thy name be called any more Abram; but thou shalt be called Abraham: because a father of many Nations I have made thee.
janvier_by_verse.6: And I will make thee increase exceedingly, and I will make thee into Nations, and kings shall come forth of thee.
janvier_by_verse.7: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee, and between thy seed after thee in their generations by a perpetual covenant: to be thy God, and thy seeds after thee.
janvier_by_verse.8: And I will give to thee, and to thy seed the land of thy peregrination, all the land of Chanaan for a perpetual possession, and I will be their God.
janvier_by_verse.9: Again God said to Abraham: And thou therefore shalt keep my covenant, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
janvier_by_verse.10: This is my covenant which you shall observe between me and you, and thy seed after thee: All the male kind of you shall be circumcised:
janvier_by_verse.11: and you shall circumcise the flesh of your prepuce, that it may be for a sign of the covenant between me and you.
janvier_by_verse.12: An infant of eight days shall be circumcised among you, all male-kind in your generations: as well the homebred shall be circumcised, as the bought servant of whosoever he is, not of your stock:
janvier_by_verse.13: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for a perpetual covenant.
janvier_by_verse.14: The male, whose flesh of his prepuce shall not be circumcised, that soul shall be destroyed out of his people: because he hath broken my covenant.
janvier_by_verse.15: God said also to Abraham: Sarai thy wife thou shalt not call Sarai, but Sara.
janvier_by_verse.16: And I will bless her, and of her I will give thee a son, whom I will bless, and he shall be into Nations, and kings of peoples shall spring of him.
janvier_by_verse.17: Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, saying in his heart: Shall trowest thou to him that is an hundred year old a son be born? And Sara that is ninety years old shall she bear?
janvier_by_verse.18: And he said to God: I would that Ismael may live before thee.
janvier_by_verse.19: And God said to Abraham: Sara thy wife shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name Isaac, and I will establish my covenant to him for a perpetual covenant, and to his seed after him.
janvier_by_verse.20: Concerning Ismael also I have heard thee. Behold, I will bless him, and increase and multiply him exceedingly: twelve Dukes shall he beget, and I will make him into a great Nation.
janvier_by_verse.21: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sara shall bring forth to thee at this time another year.
janvier_by_verse.22: And when he had left off speaking with him, God ascended from Abraham.
janvier_by_verse.23: And Abraham took Ismael his son, and all the homebred of his house: and all whom he had bought, all the males of all the men of his house: and he circumcised the flesh of their prepuce forthwith the very same day, as God had commanded him.
janvier_by_verse.24: Abraham was ninety and nine years old, when he circumcised the flesh of his prepuce.
janvier_by_verse.25: And Ismael his son was full thirteen years old at the time of his circumcision.
janvier_by_verse.26: The self-same day was Abraham circumcised and Ismael his son.
janvier_by_verse.27: And all the men of his house, as well the homebred as the bought servants and strangers were circumcised together.
